name: Resolution Slope of an Even Cycle
parameters: For $C_{2d}$ with $d\geq2$, over every coefficient field $k$.
proof: Proper-face traces are paths and contribute only linear behavior. On the full face the face complex has the homotopy type of a circle, producing a second Betti shift of excess $d$ and slope $d/2$; the ordering-width upper bound makes this maximal.
